eventMetadata.context_description: Omonia Nicosia, the 2025/26 Cypriot champions, host FC Kairat Almaty in the UEFA Champions League second qualifying round first leg at GSP Stadium. Omonia enter unbeaten across their last 13 matches with strong home form, while Kairat arrive after winning their opening qualifier against Sutjeska and maintaining a six-match winning streak. Both sides feature limited prior European head-to-head history, mostly draws from earlier Conference League ties. The return leg is scheduled for July 29 in Almaty, with advancement hinging on aggregate score, extra time, and potential away goals or penalties. Squad rotation, travel fatigue for the Kazakh side, and early-season fitness levels remain key variables ahead of the fixture.
